$comment: textify-voice bench record's prompt set (DECISIONS.md D2 / SPEC §7 / COMMANDS-SPEC C0.0). Reference text is the prompt text itself -- the whole point of a recording tool that SUPPLIES the prompt is that the reference transcript is known before the take, so there is no post-hoc human-transcription pass. Every sentence here is meant to be read aloud naturally, not lorem ipsum. 'kind: dictation' prompts feed the WP-V0.0 hard-slice corpus (fixtures/voice/manifest.json) directly. 'kind: command' and 'kind: adversarial' prompts are recorded through the exact same take/WAV/manifest pipeline (so their ASR transcripts can be scored too) but they are NOT a substitute for fixtures/commands/ -- command-intent classification (does command mode accept/reject correctly) is scored there, not by `bench score`, which only measures transcription word accuracy.

prompts.text: Please forward the Nairobi contract to Farrukh Otieno before you leave for lunch.
prompts.notes: Consonant-cluster surname with no reliable spelling-to-sound mapping -- the archetypal bias-term-mismatch trigger (SPEC 3.3).

prompts.text: Loop in Anneliese Vogt on the merger deck, she's covering for the usual lead this week.
Book a table at Kessaku for six people this Friday night.
prompts.notes: Restaurant/venue name -- 'app-name'-adjacent but not an app, so tagged 'other' per the schema's bias_term.kind enum.

prompts.text: Tell the team the Zephyrine rollout slipped to next sprint.
Can you introduce me to Oisin before the board meeting starts?
prompts.notes: Irish given name -- orthography and pronunciation diverge sharply, same failure class as 'Siobhan' in manifest.example.json.

prompts.text: The invoice needs to go to Accounts at Threadwell Logistics, not the old vendor.
The crash only happens inside handleSubmit when useEffect fires twice.
prompts.notes: camelCase identifiers spoken as natural words -- tests whether bias correction recovers coding-convention casing (AppKind::Code).

prompts.text: Set the environment variable API underscore base underscore url to h t t p s colon slash slash api dot textify dot dev.
prompts.notes: Dictated as literal spoken punctuation -- tests bias-layer-2 literal substitution rules (SPEC 3.3: 'cursor dot ai' -> 'cursor.ai').

prompts.text: Rename the getUserProfile function to fetchUserProfile across the whole repo.
The bug is in parseManifestSchema, it throws on an empty bias underscore terms array.
Push the fix to the feature slash voice dash spine branch before you open the pull request.
Import BiasContext from voice dash core and pass it into normalize.
I was thinking we could push the launch back a week if the numbers don't look right.
prompts.notes: No bias terms on purpose -- isolates raw acoustic-model accent robustness from the bias pipeline. Record this with a non-US-English accent; the sentence text itself is deliberately plain. Pass --speaker-accent at record time.

prompts.text: Could you double check the invoice before it goes out to the client tomorrow?
The forecast says rain all weekend, so maybe we move the picnic indoors.
He mentioned the flight got delayed, so we should plan for a late arrival.
Please loop in Zhi Wei and Amara before we merge the pull request into main.
prompts.notes: Stacks accented-en with proper-noun -- the intersection SPEC §7 expects local ASR to hurt most, same pairing pattern as accented-en-02 in manifest.example.json.

prompts.text: Let's regroup after lunch and figure out who's covering the afternoon shift.
Don't wake the dog, the delivery guy is right outside the door.
prompts.direction: Whisper this line -- no voiced tone at all, breath only. Not just quiet normal speech.
prompts.notes: Whispered speech lacks fundamental frequency (F0) entirely -- a quiet normal-voice take does not reproduce the same acoustic failure mode.

prompts.notes: COMMANDS-SPEC C0.0 dictation-lookalike-adversarial -- leading subject/verb clause ('I told him to') before the trigger verb, must reject at >=99% in command mode (COMMANDS-SPEC 241). Recorded here for ASR reference-text only.
